name: Character Prompt Slot Spec (not a workflow)
description: Source of truth for how every THE FOUR SEASONS character prompt is assembled. Not runnable via MCP run_workflow - it is a data file consumed when building the PARAM_PROMPT value for char_ipadapter / char_ipadapter_controlnet / char_ipadapter_dual. Join slot_order with ', ' to produce the positive prompt. The assembled string is mirrored into each wiki outfit sheet; if the two disagree, this file wins. Regenerate the sheets rather than editing them by hand.
